contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Split text retaining empty fields. Parse each field with typed-decimal rules: remove all ECMAScript whitespace, accept a first decimal comma only if no dot exists, and accept signed plain decimal without exponent or suffix. Substitute fallback separately for invalid fields, then sum from left to right starting at zero.
contract.domain: Text arguments contain at most 64 Unicode code points each and no lone surrogate code units. Indices and lengths count code points, not UTF-16 units. Inputs are unchanged; returned arrays are fresh. Separator is nonempty; fields have at most 20 characters and accepted values are finite between -1000 and 1000. Fallback is finite between -1000 and 1000.

inputRoles.fallback: value added for each invalid field

contract.outputRole: left-to-right sum of all parsed or fallback field values
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
